title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.

title: Talk 1
original: Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.

title: Talk 2
original: I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.

title: Talk 3
original: People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.

title: Idle
original: Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.

title: Onboard
original: Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I have learned a lot. Thank you.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.

title: Added to Squad
original: What can I do for you?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.

title: Depart
original: Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.

title: Begin Operation
original: They probably won't make it to tomorrow.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Awarting orders.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Gladly!

title: Deployment 1
original: Got it.

title: Deployment 2
original: Understood.

title: In Battle 1
original: Freeze!

title: In Battle 2
original: Down you go.

title: 4-star Result
original: With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.

title: 3-star Result
original: A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.

title: Operation Failure
original: Did we make a mistake somewhere...?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.

title: Greeting
original: Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! And allow me to be your personal butler today! Steward, at your service.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.
